title: Meet Local & International Friends - Casual Socialising Evening- Music & DJ
description: Looking for a fun and friendly way to spend your Friday evening in Lisbon? Whether you live here, recently moved to the city, or you're simply passing through while travelling, you're very welcome to join us! International Friends Lisbon is a growing community of local Portuguese and international people who come together regularly. Some people are joining for the first time, while others return week after week to catch up with familiar faces. Come alone or bring your friends — either way, you'll be welcome! ❤️ 🃏 LET'S MAKE SOCIALISING EASIER! Walking into a busy social event can sometimes feel a little awkward - so we make it easier! We run fun matching and connection activities to get people moving around, talking and mixing with different people. Nothing complicated - just a bit of fun to get conversations started! 😄 🎁 FUN COMMUNITY RAFFLE We also have a fun raffle draw during the evening, adding a little extra excitement to the night! 🕖 COME EARLY & ENJOY THE WHOLE EVENING Doors open at 7:00 PM, and we strongly recommend arriving early. The first part of the evening is all about socialising, conversations, activities and enjoying the community atmosphere. 🎧 From around 11:00 PM, we have a DJ playing in one side of the venue giving you the choice between ending your night with a fun dance or continue socialising in other rooms of the venue. Most of our attendees stay till 1:00 AM. You're welcome to stay and enjoy the music until 3:00 AM. ❤️ FRIENDSHIP & COMMUNITY FIRST We want our events to be somewhere people feel comfortable coming back to week after week, seeing familiar faces and becoming part of the community. A few simple things help us keep that atmosphere: • Respect everyone's personal space and boundaries. • This is a friendship-focused community event. • Please avoid unwanted romantic pressure. • Please maintain respect on the dance floor. • Please don't use our events to promote business, services or other events. • Be friendly, considerate and help others feel included. Come to have fun, meet people and be a positive part of the community. ❤️ 💛 FREE TO ATTEND • DONATION BASED There's no fixed **entrance fee.** **If you'd like to support the community, please contribute whatever amount** you feel comfortable with when you arrive.
